units.source_text: 薰大将虽然有心攀登“筑波山”，

en.t: Although General Kaoru wished to climb "Mount Tsukuba,"

units.source_text: 但倘强欲身入“丛林密”处，将被世人讥评为轻率，不当稳便。

en.t: if he forced himself into the "dense forest," people would ridicule him as rash and improper.

units.source_text: 因此心生顾虑，并不直接写信给浮舟，

en.t: For that reason, he became cautious and did not write directly to Ukifune,

units.source_text: 只是叫老尼姑弁君屡次向她母亲中将君隐约表示求爱之意。

en.t: but merely had the old nun Ben no Kimi repeatedly hint at his courtship to her mother, Chujo no Kimi.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲认为薰大将不会真心恋爱她的女儿。

en.t: Ukifune's mother thought that General Kaoru could not truly be in love with her daughter.

units.source_text: 只觉得承蒙这位贵人如此用心寻找，实甚荣幸。

en.t: She only felt deeply honored that this noble gentleman had taken such pains to seek her out.

units.source_text: 她想：“这是当代一等红人，我的女儿若得身份相当，可知好哩。”

en.t: She thought, "He is one of the foremost favorites of the age; if only my daughter were of suitable rank, how fine that would be."
Her mind was full of hesitation.
